title: WakeflowPrepareDeliveryRequestV1
description: Append one delivery for a planned, rework-requested, product-defect-rework-requested, test-another-attempt-requested, or rejected-before-send (rearm-exhausted) target: take the window work claim, render the prompt skeleton, and return the one-shot permit.
$comment: Append shape (ADR-0012 D2): idempotencyKey plus expectedStreamRevision. Implementation and test targets share the tool; Wakeflow derives the work type, the rework or remediation context, and the test attempt from the Demand state.

root.description: Absolute path of the existing Wakeflow workspace root.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key binding this request to at most one commit.

expectedStreamRevision.description: Demand stream revision the caller observed; a stale value is rejected.

authored.description: Controller 撰写的三段人话：目标、完成焦点（至多两条）、关键边界；其余骨架由 Wakeflow 渲染。
